questions.question:
In the following diagram, the hexagon stands for 'boys', the rectangle stands for 'sportspersons', and the triangle stands for 'musicians'. The letters given in the different segments represent persons belonging to that category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47dafb4633e841a3d5edce3bd426d8c9426ad841d6f56fd321d517f293f69973.png] 

Which category is represented by the letter 'f'?

options.text: Musicians who are boys and sportspersons both
Boys who are musicians but not sportspersons
Boys who are sportspersons but not musicians
Sportspersons who are musicians but not boys

questions.solution:
The category represented by the letter 'f' is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09d466d26e397251a86822ad9c364fc96b040b511e20068c70660a8fa68ba6cd.png] 

 

 
• Musicians who are boys and sportspersons both → b
 
• **Boys who are musicians but not sportspersons → f**
 
• Boys who are sportspersons but not musicians → d
 
• Sportspersons who are musicians but not boys → c

Hence, '**Boys who are musicians but not sportspersons**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: ‘Europe’ is related to ‘Switzerland’ in the same way as ‘Asia’ is related to ‘_______’.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• ‘Europe’ is related to ‘Switzerland’ → **Switzerland **is a mountainous Central **European** country.

Similarly,

 
• ‘Asia’ is related to ‘_______’ → **Japan** is an island country in East **Asia**. 

Hence, '**Japan**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some bolts are pens.

Some stencils are bolts.

All screws are bolts.

Conclusions:

I. No screw is a stencil.

II. Some pens are stencils.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48512a2f8aef1f5fb9444486a282a657a607e22e525d8a7a5b5714c2b72323d0.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No screw is a stencil. → Do not follow (As, there is no definite relation between screw and stencil. Hence, false)

II. Some pens are stencils. → Do not follow (As, there is no definite relation between pen and stencil. Hence, false) 

Hence, **Neither conclusion I nor II follows**.

questions.question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a08c777a36f898d492c29ef3a13c1a9aad5b988568e613e5a9282d9466dd8871.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** 1st letter + 3 = 3rd letter; 2nd letter + 2 = 4th letter

 
• **BXEV → B + 3 = E; X - 2 = V**
 
• HDKF → H +3 = K; D + 2 = F
 
• RNUP → R + 3 = U; N + 2 = P
 
• TPWR → T + 3 = W; P + 2 = R

Hence, '**BXEV**' is the odd one out.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

36, 74, 55
questions.solution:
• The logic followed here is:
 
• 36, 74, 55 → (36 + 74) ÷ 2 = 110 ÷ 2 = 55

Similarly,

 
• 40, 52, 46 → (40 + 52) ÷ 2 = 92 ÷ 2 = 46

Hence, '**40, 52, 46**' is the correct answer.

A dice (x) is rotated three times in similar manner. Two of its positions (x.1 and x.2) are given. Select the next possible position from the following options.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d370dade4091deacd8a56bdfc727e384153426f8cfe1d883e5560b584b3c541.png]
questions.solution:
A dice (x) is rotated three times in similar manner. Two of its positions (x.1 and x.2) are given. The next possible position from the following options is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed58920d577fbd4979b54deb40a49f8ea091e7261b061de766001ca6500039ef.png] 

From dice x and x1, we get that 6 and 1 are opposite faces.

From dice x1 and x2, we get that 2 and 5 are opposite faces.

Remaining faces 4 and 3 will be opposite, to each other.

So, next dice must have either 6 or 1 at the right hand side position.

As in the options, we see only option 4 has 6 at the right hand side position with 3 at the front face and 5 at the top.

Hence, '**option 4**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
​Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

Q _ P _ M _ A _ T _ Q A _ T M

options.text: A T Q P M Q
A T Q P Q P
A T Q P M P
A Q T P M P

questions.solution:
Given sequence: Q _ P _ M _ A _ T _ Q A _ T M

 
• A T Q P M Q → Q **A** P **T** M - **Q** A **P** T **M** - Q A **Q** T M
 
• A T Q P Q P → Q A P T M - Q A P T Q - Q A P T M
 
• A T Q P M P → Q A P T M - Q A P T M - Q A P T M
 
• A Q T P M P → Q A P Q M - T A P T M - Q A P T M

 
• In option 3, QAPTM is repeated.

Hence, '**A T Q P M P**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Akram, Nagesh, Girish, Vikram and Satpal are sitting at the five corners of a pentagon shaped table; all are facing the centre of the table. Girish is third to the left of Vikram. Satpal is to the immediate left of Nagesh. Akram is second to the left of Satpal. Who is sitting second to the right of Nagesh?
questions.solution:
**Akram, Nagesh, Girish, Vikram and Satpal **are sitting at the five corners of a pentagon shaped table; all are facing the centre of the table. 

1. Satpal is to the immediate left of Nagesh.

2. Akram is second to the left of Satpal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d766382690ff1f6131088e97007224e482d797c21a4ef94959ed2cf79e042c4.png] 

3. Girish is third to the left of Vikram. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bc2f62cf51649f0c01a49f655fc713063faa06991f400a910b674df9c5eb764.png] 

Akram is sitting second to the right of Nagesh.

Hence, '**Akram**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

13 : 163 : : 11 : ? : : 9 : 75
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• 13 : 163 → 13² - 6 = 169 - 6 = 163
 
• 9 : 75 → 92 - 6 = 81 - 6 = 75

Similarly,

 
• 11 : ? → 112 - 6 = 121 - 6 = 115

Hence, '**115**' is the correct answer.
